remaining: Plume is rooted along the rising shaft and has crisp dark tips plus a continuous white inner band, but its long smooth spear-like locks still differ from the sheet compact layered tufts.
Bib and hind-leg feathering remain silkier and have more fine fringe than the sheet nested wiry tufts. Body clumps are visibly coarser than pass1.

independent.review_type: Independent adversarial visual review of delivered final images and fresh deformation proof
independent.approval: No Nick approval. No exact sheet-match claim.
independent.assessment: Substantial visible improvement over pass 1 and live pass 3, with the major requested changes present. The final groom still differs materially from the sheet in tuft scale and layering, plume lock character, and face realism. Technical artifact checks below found no obvious severe failure in the inspected images. These two judgments are separate.

residuals_first.finding: The sheet has denser, shorter, layered pointed tufts with clear dark separations. Final body fur is much sharper than pass 1, but still has fine bright fringe along the back and longer silky bib and hind-feathering elements. The render is shaggy, but its clump rhythm differs visibly from the sheet.
residuals_first.next_action_if_another_pass_is_authorize: Shorten exceptional silhouette hairs and layer smaller pointed locks within the bib and feathering while retaining the required regional length hierarchy.

residuals_first.finding: The smoky brush is replaced by compact, slate-colored pointed locks. The white inner band is continuous and roots extend along the upturn. However, locks remain longer, smoother and more spear-like than the sheet's dense layered tufts. The white band is narrower and less prominent than the reference, especially near the plume base. Some fine fringe persists at extreme tips. The dark channels between lower locks read as recessed gaps, not clearly detached or bald artifacts.
residuals_first.next_action_if_another_pass_is_authorize: Broaden white coverage along the inner base and break long smooth locks into smaller nested strand clumps without restoring a diffuse halo.

residuals_first.finding: Short facial fur, dark eye surrounds, white whiskers and whisker-pad dots are now visible. The final high-resolution head resolves the earlier uncertainty about pad dots. Eyes remain exposed amber button-like forms with flat horizontal pupils and round highlights. The nose still has a sharply rectangular outer boundary. These remain conspicuous realism differences from the sheet, even though the requested horizontal goat pupil is retained.
residuals_first.next_action_if_another_pass_is_authorize: Keep sculpt geometry fixed. Refine iris-edge variation, corneal depth cues and the short white fur transition at the nose perimeter. Do not replace the required horizontal pupil merely to copy the reference's rounder eye.

residuals_first.finding: At native 192 px, pass 2 has visibly more coat texture and a sharper, narrower plume than pass 1. The white plume band and individual whiskers are weak at that size. At native 512 px, the matched portrait framing shows a clear gain in facial and body fur texture, eye rims, whisker visibility and bronze horn crests. Neither comparison establishes equivalence to the sheet.
residuals_first.next_action_if_another_pass_is_authorize: Judge further plume-band and contrast changes at native sprite size as well as in close-up.

color_check.method: Independently recomputed the median RGB from render_side.png using the documented fixed boxes in color_measurements.json with Pillow and NumPy. These are local patch results, not whole-coat averages.
color_check.finding: Documented patch numbers reproduce and are close to requested values, with R greater than B in dark patches. Broader three-quarter appearance is still lighter than the sheet in places due to lighting and strand highlights; do not extrapolate these patches to every view.

bald_patches.result: No obvious large unintended bald patch on body, face, legs or bent pose. Dark lower plume gaps remain visible but do not clearly expose a bald failure.

hair_poking_through_itself_in_spikes.result: No obvious explosive or erroneous crossing spikes. Intentional body and plume points remain; smooth spear-like plume locks are a style residual, not classified as an attachment artifact.

floating_strands.result: No detached strand cloud or visible root separation. Fine fringe exists but appears rooted.

hair_inside_eyes_or_over_nose.result: No obvious strand crosses the iris center or bare nose center. Short fur frames both edges. Horn shafts and claw tips remain bare.

buried_toes.result: Dark short fur covers paw tops. Toe ends and small claws remain visible in front, three-quarter and hind close-up. Toes are subtler than the sheet but not buried into featureless blobs.

dark_or_black_spots.result: No isolated black body rendering artifact seen. Dark eye rims, paws and recessed plume channels are coherent with material or occlusion.

left_right_asymmetry.result: No obvious major groom imbalance in final front. Small stochastic tuft variation remains. A thin vertical sliver between horns appears to be distant plume overlap.

leg_pattern.result: White fronts and insides of forelegs are plainly present; hind feathering includes white coverage. Dark paw tops correct the pale-slipper read.

ground_clearance.result: Hind feathering ends above the ground in final close-up; no clear floor penetration seen.

deformation_review.finding: Fresh proof shows fur carried with the bent hind leg without a detached cloud, new bald seam or explosive spike. Paws overlap in the temporary pose, so this is attachment evidence rather than an animation-quality pose.
deformation_review.limit: A single bent pose does not establish every rig deformation, collision case or future groom reapplication. Numerical binding evidence must be reported separately.

comparison_review.all_eight_sheet_composites: Inspected side, three_quarter, front, head, hind_leg, tail_plume, portrait and sprite comparisons. They are labeled and show the render beside the matching reference or documented detail crop.
comparison_review.live_pass3: Both side and three-quarter comparisons clearly show the move from a smooth texture-driven asset to dimensional strand fur. Different lighting and framing mean they are qualitative quality-step comparisons, not controlled color measurements.
comparison_review.pass1_native_sizes: Both 192 px sprite and 512 px portrait comparisons inspected at native displayed sizes. Portrait framing is matched and permits a fairer texture comparison.
comparison_review.geometry_limit: Reference and sculpt proportions and camera projection still differ. This review does not recommend changing the read-only approved sculpt to erase those differences.

independent.scope: All eight final view contents were inspected, including portrait and sprite through their native-size composites; all twelve requested comparison composites and fresh final deformation images were inspected. No Blender execution, groom edits or geometry changes were performed by this reviewer. Cost measurements, sculpt hashes and numeric binding tests are outside this visual audit except for the explicitly reproduced color patches.
independent.final_status: Reviewed with substantive visual residuals. No Nick approval and no exact-match claim.
